name: Eleven-Set Bouquet That Is Not a Convex-Geometry Ideal
definition: On $E=\{1,2,3,4\}$ take $\mathcal B_{11}=\{\varnothing,1,2,3,4,12,14,23,34,123,234\}$, where a digit string denotes its support.
properties: It is a bouquet of convex geometries, hence a conditional antimatroid, ample, and dismantlable. In the displayed orientation it is not a lower ideal of any convex geometry, even after enlarging the ambient ground set.
